name_zh: 马尔代夫·毛姆·阿卜杜勒·加尤姆：苏丹伊斯兰贸易与印度洋珊瑚
name_en: Maldives Maumoon Abdul Gayoom: Sultan Islam Trade & Indian Ocean Coral
description_zh: 毛姆·阿卜杜勒·加尤姆 (1937-) 马尔代夫总统 (1978-2008)，亚洲最长任独裁者(30年)，伊斯兰法治与旅游开发并行，珊瑚礁保护与海平面上升双重挑战，2008年民主化让权。
description_en: Maumoon Abdul Gayoom (1937-) Maldives President (1978-2008), Asia longest-serving dictator (30 years), Islamic law and tourism development parallel, coral reef protection and sea level rise dual challenges, 2008 democratization handover.
reason_zh: 加尤姆代表小岛国如何通过旅游经济与伊斯兰身份维持长期统治，展示了珊瑚生态系统如何支撑国家经济基础，其三十年统治与和平让权形成独特对比。
reason_en: Gayoom represents how small island state maintains long-term rule through tourism economy and Islamic identity, demonstrating how coral ecosystem supports national economic base, his 30-year rule and peaceful handover forming unique contrast.
steps_zh: 研究加尤姆早年阿尔及尔大学伊斯兰法学教育
分析1978年上台与旅游业引领经济腾飞
探讨伊斯兰法治与珊瑚礁海洋保护区建设
评估海平面上升生存威胁与国际气候倡导
总结苏丹伊斯兰贸易印度洋珊瑚对马尔代夫发展模式的三十年塑造
steps_en: Study Gayoom early Algiers University Islamic law education
Analyze 1978 accession and tourism-led economic takeoff
Explore Islamic law and coral reef marine protected areas construction
Evaluate sea level rise existential threat and international climate advocacy
Summarize Sultan Islam trade Indian Ocean coral thirty-year shaping of Maldives development model
expected_zh: 理解旅游经济与伊斯兰身份如何共生支撑独裁合法性，掌握珊瑚生态系统作为国家经济命脉的脆弱性，评估加尤姆和平让权对马尔代夫民主化的奠基贡献。
expected_en: Understand how tourism economy and Islamic identity symbiosis support dictator legitimacy, grasp coral ecosystem fragility as national economic lifeline, evaluate Gayoom peaceful handover foundational contribution for Maldives democratization.
case_zh: 1937 出生；1978 总统；1998 拒签京都议定书；2008 让权。苏丹伊斯兰贸易珊瑚范式永存。
case_en: 1937 birth; 1978 President; 1998 rejected Kyoto Protocol; 2008 handover. Sultan Islam trade Indian Ocean coral paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Islamic Autocracy / Tourism Development / Climate Vulnerability
cross_cultural_impact: Tourism development model; Islamic law; coral reef; peaceful transition
